indications: Venofer is indicated for the treatment of iron deficiency anemia (IDA) in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD).
contraindications: Venofer must only be administered intravenously either by slow injection or by infusion.  The dosage of Venofer is expressed in mg of elemental iron.  Each mL contains 20 mg of elemental iron.
name: Venofer
